label: Isolation raise vs limpers - 6-max
source: Hand-authored exploitative chart for loose-passive microstakes pools. There is no GTO equivalent: solvers are never given a limping opponent, so no solver output exists for this node. Reasoning: a limper's range is capped (no premiums) and the pot holds dead money, but fold equity collapses because a station-type limper calls. So this chart is value-heavier and NARROWER than a steal-oriented RFI range from the same seat -- BTN opens 44% first-in on fold equity it will not get here. Weakest link in the tool: these numbers are judgement, not solver output, and the observed-vs-chart gap should be read as 'worth investigating', not as a verdict.
